paper.title: Finite-Time Analysis of Kernelised Contextual Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Kernelised (non-linear) contextual bandit with N actions and rewards linear in RKHS features
unmapped: Expected reward is E(r_{a,t}|x_{a,t}) = phi(x_{a,t})^T theta* for theta* in the RKHS; regret compares to the per-round best action given the contexts
settings.definition_quote: For our non-linear contextual bandit model we assume the existence of a φ for which there exists a θ∗ ∈ H such that: E(ra,t | xa,t ) = φ(xa,t )T θ∗ . Taking a∗t := arg maxa∈A {φ(xa,t )T θ∗ } we can define the regret as before in (1).

bound.expression_latex: R(T) \le \Big[2 + 2\big(1+\sqrt{\gamma/(2\ln(2TN(1+\ln T)/\delta))}\big)\|\theta^*\| + 8\sqrt{(12+15/\gamma)\max\{\ln(T/(\tilde d\gamma)+1),\ln T\}^3}\sqrt{2\ln\frac{2TN(1+\ln T)}{\delta}}\Big]\sqrt{\tilde d T}

symbols.theta_norm: RKHS norm ||theta*|| of the unknown reward parameter
symbols.gamma_reg: regularisation parameter gamma of the kernel ridge regression
symbols.d_eff: effective dimension d_tilde = min{j : j*gamma*ln T >= sum_{i>j} (lambda_{i,T} - gamma)}, eigenvalues of Phi^T Phi + gamma I

source.quote: Assume that kφ(xa,t )k ≤ 1 and |ra,t | ∈ [0, 1] for all a ∈ A and t ≥ 1, and set η = sqrt(2 ln 2T N/δ). Then with probability 1 − δ, SupKernelUCB satisfies: R(T) ≤ [2 + 2(1 + sqrt(γ/(2 ln(2TN(1+lnT)/δ))))kθ∗k + 8 sqrt((12 + 15/γ) max(ln(T/(d̃γ)+1), ln T)^3) × sqrt(2 ln(2TN(1+lnT)/δ))] sqrt(d̃T)

results.notes: Paper's N (number of actions) mapped to K. The expression was reconstructed from pdftotext output, so the bracket structure and the cube on the max are inferred from the proof. The proof's first term actually scales with sqrt(T), not sqrt(dT). Remark 3 informally gives Õ(sqrt(L d T)) when gamma ~ 1/L for ||theta*|| <= L, and Õ(||theta*|| sqrt(dT)) for constant gamma. The bound is data-dependent through d_tilde.
